en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting an urban street scene with horse-drawn trams and late 19th or early 20th-century European architecture. The main focus is on a large building labeled as 'Hotel Daniel,' with another significant building beside it likely being the 'Südbahnhof' (South Railway Station). People are seen walking, and the square appears to be a notable intersection in the city.
